about: The falsifier: the rebirth landed at epoch 274 named a toolchain and read the world where it ran. It skipped node_modules by name while walking the clone, called a tsconfig file stray by name, and ran verify in process.cwd(); the ceilings on what bound's code names read all three over. The clone holds only what the release carried, so nothing has to be skipped by name; a stray is a leaf the rebirth left that the release did not carry; verify runs in the clone.
